en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a cobblestone street bordered by historic multistory buildings. Several pedestrians in early 20th-century attire are visible, including women in dresses and men in hats and suits. There are prominent signs on several buildings, including 'Otto Bri... Tuch-Lager,' 'OBERHOF,' and 'C. Thriemer.' The architectural style of the buildings is distinctly Central European, with ornate windows and gabled roofs.
